extDescription.message: Open alphaXiv papers on arXiv as abstracts, PDFs, or experimental HTML. Keep versions, copy links, and use a shortcut.

commandOpenArxiv.message: Open the current paper on arXiv using your reading preferences

htmlNote.message: Experimental HTML availability depends on the paper version. You can also choose Abstract or PDF.

storageNote.message: Preferences are saved in this browser

versionNote.message: Keep the version in the source link. Unversioned links open the latest paper.

emptyNote.message: Open a paper page, or paste a paper link or arXiv ID above.

openFailed.message: Opening failed. Refresh the paper page and try again.

copySucceeded.message: Copied the arXiv link using your version preference.

copyFailed.message: Copying failed. Keep this panel open and try again.

shortcutInstructions.message: Open chrome://extensions/shortcuts to configure the shortcut.

dockOpenNew.message: Open arXiv $1 in a new tab

dockCopyFailed.message: Copying failed. Try again in the extension panel.

reloadExtension.message: Refresh this page to reload the extension.

invalidTab.message: Reopen the extension and try again.

unsupportedPage.message: Open an alphaXiv or arXiv paper first.

latestVersionNote.message: Open and copy the latest version of this paper.
